system.description: Spend 2 Echo to shift the spotlight from an adversary to an ally within Far range. The GM may still spend a Fear to interrupt, but only by making a move with a different adversary.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v1.0 Heart

system.gmNotes: Spend Echo from the class feature that holds it: the system can only charge a cost to the resource on the same item, so this Echo cost is paid by hand.
